01 — Android · Reminders

RING PING.

Reminders you can't ignore.

A reminder app that rings your Android phone like an incoming call. It goes full screen, even when the phone is locked, and calls back until you act.

Why it exists

A notification is easy to miss. A phone call is not.

A reminder notification buzzes once, lands in a tray with forty others and is gone by the time it matters. A call is different. It takes over the screen, it makes noise and it keeps going until you deal with it.

Ring Ping turns a reminder into that call. At the set minute your Android phone rings full screen, even when it is locked, and Cola, the koala assistant, reads the reminder out loud. Miss it and she calls back.

How it works

  1. 1

    Add a reminder

    Tap + or just tell Cola: “wake me up at 6:30 on weekdays”.

  2. 2

    Your phone rings

    At that minute the phone rings full screen, even when it is locked.

  3. 3

    Answer and get it done

    Cola reads the reminder out loud. Missed it? She calls back.

What it does

Built for Anyone who misses notifications, including many people with ADHD. It covers medicine, wake-ups, meetings, bills, workouts and calling family.

  1. 01

    Rings like a real call

    Full-screen call that keeps ringing until you act, even on a locked phone.

  2. 02

    Call-backs

    Missed it? Ring Ping calls back. Three tries by default, adjustable per reminder.

  3. 03

    Ask Cola

    An assistant that creates, moves or cancels reminders from plain words or your voice. Hands-free with "Hey Cola".

  4. 04

    Calendar & repeats

    Month, week, day and schedule views with daily, weekday, weekly, monthly and yearly repeats.

  5. 05

    Share with family

    Send a reminder as a link. No account needed to open it.

  6. 06

    Works offline

    Runs fully offline on Android. Optional free account for web sync and backup.

Inside the product

Real screens from ringping.space, captured 12 November 2026. Select any one to enlarge it.

Decisions that shaped it

Call back, don’t nag
A second notification is as easy to ignore as the first. A second call is not. Three tries by default, and you can change that for each reminder.
Free, with no ads
No ads and no subscriptions. It runs fully offline on Android. An account is optional and only adds web sync and backup.
Words before forms
“Move my dentist to Friday” is faster than five taps. Cola shows the change before she makes it, and every change can be undone.
Easy to share
A reminder can be sent as a link on WhatsApp. The person taps Add and Cola calls them too, with no account needed to open it.
